items.source: Sets the given source on the given AbstractBeanDefinition and registers it inside the given BeanDefinitionRegistry. For BeanDefinitions to be registered once-and-only-once for all configuration elements (annotation or XML), prefer calling registerIfNotAlreadyRegistered(Supplier, BeanDefinitionRegistry, String, Object) with a dedicated bean name to avoid the bead definition being registered multiple times.

items.source: Base implementation of RepositoryConfigurationExtension to ease the implementation of the interface. Will default the default named query location based on a module prefix provided by implementors (see getModulePrefix()). Stubs out the post-processing methods as they might not be needed by default.

items.source: Returns whether the given repository metadata is a candidate for bean definition creation in the strict repository detection mode. The default implementation inspects the domain type managed for a set of well-known annotations (see getIdentifyingAnnotations()). If none of them is found, the candidate is discarded. Implementations should make sure, the only return true if they're really sure the interface handed to the method is really a store interface.
items.translation: 返回给定的仓库元数据是否为严格仓库检测模式中的 Bean 定义创建候选项。默认实现会检查一组知名注解所管理的域类型（参见 getIdentifyingAnnotations()）。如果未找到其中任何一个，则该候选项将被丢弃。实现应确保仅在确实确定传递给该方法的是存储接口时才返回 true。
